final:
Implemented `min_absolute_difference` using a rolling set of distinct subarray OR values, giving roughly O(n × bit-width) time.

**Publication is blocked by a contradictory test.** The specification and docstring example require `min_absolute_difference([1, 3, 1, 3], 2) == 1`: a one-element subarray `[1]` has OR 1, and `[3]` has OR 3, each at distance 1 from 2. But `tests.py` asserts the result is 2. The implementation follows the stated behavior; the publishing service rejected it on that assertion, so no release was published. All other supplied checks passed when run separately.
